import re

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def normalize_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    s = str(value)
    s = s.replace("\xa0", " ")
    s = s.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    s = s.replace("“", '"').replace("”", '"')
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s.casefold()

# Locate columns from headers

        headers[normalize_text(cell.value)] = cell.column

search_col = headers["search term"]
category_col = headers["category name"]
bank_col = headers["bank statement item name"]

# Build the ordered list of search terms and their assigned categories
search_pairs = []
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    term = ws.cell(row=row, column=search_col).value
    if normalize_text(term):
        search_pairs.append((normalize_text(term), ws.cell(row=row, column=category_col).value))

# Fill exactly F2:F12 with the reverse lookup result
for row in range(2, 13):
    bank_text = normalize_text(ws.cell(row=row, column=bank_col).value)
    result = "Other"
    for term_text, category in search_pairs:
        if term_text in bank_text:

output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/56975_0_3f791bb6/1_56975_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def norm_text_for_search(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    s = str(value)
    s = s.replace("\xa0", " ")
    s = s.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    s = s.replace("“", '"').replace("”", '"')
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s.casefold()

# Locate columns by header text so the solution is not tied to preview-only positions.
headers = {}
for cell in ws[1]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        headers[str(cell.value).strip().casefold()] = cell.column

search_col = headers.get("search term", 1)
category_col = headers.get("category name", 2)
bank_col = headers.get("bank statement item name", 4)

# Build ordered search-term/category pairs from the raw source columns.
pairs = []
for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    term = ws.cell(r, search_col).value
    if term is None or norm_text_for_search(term) == "":
        continue
    pairs.append((norm_text_for_search(term), ws.cell(r, category_col).value))

# Fill only the requested answer cells F2:F12.
for r in range(2, 13):
    bank_value = ws.cell(r, bank_col).value
    bank_norm = norm_text_for_search(bank_value)
    result = "Other"
    for term_norm, category in pairs:
        if term_norm and term_norm in bank_norm:
            result = category
            break
    ws.cell(r, 6).value = result

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
